title: RecordTitleChip: the record title collapses to ~30px ("S…") when the header carries three wide action buttons at ~800px
body:
## What happens

Console at 799px viewport (the Claude Code browser pane; any tablet/narrow-desktop width), objectstack showcase, record `Field Zoo → Specimen — Full` (`/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_field_zoo/record/<id>`):

- The `h1` renders **"S…"**. Measured twice on fresh loads (zh-CN and en): `h1.getBoundingClientRect().width` = 29.5px and 39.1px; its parent `div.flex.items-baseline.gap-2.flex-wrap` and the grandparent `div.flex.flex-col.min-w-0` have the same width — the title column has been starved to nothing.
- The same header on an Account record (`编辑` + more + refresh only) renders fine: `h1` 217px inside a 535px parent.
- The difference is the action toolbar: Field Zoo declares three record-header actions (`Action Param Gallery`, `查找 == 多值第一项`, `归我所有（owner_id）`) plus more + refresh, and the `min-w-0` title column yields all its width to them.

Source: `packages/components/src/custom/RecordTitleChip.tsx:102` (`flex items-baseline gap-2 flex-wrap` under a `flex flex-col min-w-0` column). objectui @ 67dadd602a3a.

## Expected

The title keeps a minimum readable width (or the whole title) and the actions wrap, shrink to icons, or overflow into the "more" menu — never the other way round. The breadcrumb still shows the full name, which is how one notices the header is blank.

## Repro

`pnpm dev` (showcase) at :3000, console at ≤ ~820px width, open any Field Zoo record; or any object whose record header carries three or more labelled actions.

Found during the objectstack pin-bump dogfood (objectstack#14295).
